items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: he came in here just by himself. And, uh, he was loafing. And, uh, he played a few dances here with us.

ctx.x: What about Walter Barnes? Now, how would he compare with those fellows?
Well, Walter Barnes, he could play saxophone. He was, he was good. Well, he was just fine on sax. I thought I did.
